manaNeeded: {2} if you don't control a Treasure
notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
description:
If you control a Treasure, activate it by sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color. If you don't control a Treasure, activate another artifact by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that is also a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasure.
If needed, resolve the ability from step 1, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
